for i in range(1 << N):
    current_sum = 0
    for j in range(N):
        if (i >> j) & 1:
            current_sum += X[j]
    subset_sums.add(current_sum)

# Find the minimum absolute difference to the target

print(f"Minimum absolute difference (d_min) to {TARGET}: {min_diff}")
